title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy media-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
description: The media-src directive permits plaintext HTTP audio and video, so the stream the page presents can be replaced or altered in transit.
applicability: Responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit media-src directive.
risk: An attacker on the path substitutes media content and learns which asset the page played; LOW because the substituted content is not executable.
